name: Quy Nhon food guide
summary: Start with bún chả cá on Nguyễn Huệ. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định calls it the city's best-known bowl: fish cake and a broth from fish bone and fish head. Báo Người Lao Động says that broth is not pork bone, and that the cake has no dill. The provincial chả cá account adds dill. A price is Check on arrival.
body: The pancake is bánh xèo tôm nhảy. Báo Người Lao Động, 3 Apr 2019, describes small freshwater shrimp on a thin yellow batter. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định, writing about Mỹ Cang in Tuy Phước, says the shrimp is brackish tôm đất from the Thị Nại lagoon. Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định puts the cake on Diên Hồng and Đống Đa on a cool evening, and says the menu also includes squid, beef, and egg. All three stay.

Morning is bánh hỏi, which the provincial portal traces to Diêu Trì, and hủ tiếu mì hoành thánh on Ngô Thời Nhiệm. Bún nem sits in the center with no street named. Bánh mì lagu is the pork soup in a lane off Nguyễn Huệ. The shop is not named. Night snacks are on Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở. Snails are on Tăng Bạt Hổ, Mai Xuân Thưởng, and Đào Duy Từ. Seafood meals go to Xuân Diệu, Nguyễn Huệ, and the area near the Quy Nhơn–Nhơn Hội bridge.

Rượu Bàu Đá is distilled at Cù Lâm in An Nhơn, stronger than 50 degrees on the provincial portal. The tourism portal pairs it with the seafood at Hòn Khô. Where a clock or a price was not printed, it is Check on arrival. The 2019 đồng figures are not repeated.
specialtiesLead: Twenty-one plates are eaten in the city or named for it. Nine more sit in other Binh Dinh towns, with the town printed on each row.
seoTitle: Quy Nhon food — bun cha ca, banh xeo, banh hoi
seoDescription: Quy Nhon bún chả cá, bánh xèo tôm nhảy, bánh hỏi, and bánh ít lá gai, from the Binh Dinh portal and the 2 May 2019 tourism article. A price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Quy Nhon specialties
paragraphs: These are the plates addressed to the city, or placed on a city street. Bún chả cá and chả cá disagree on dill: Báo Người Lao Động leaves it out, and the provincial chả cá account puts scallion and dill in the cake. Bánh xèo tôm nhảy disagrees on the shrimp: freshwater in the 2019 newspaper, Thị Nại lagoon shrimp on the Mỹ Cang account. Both figures stay.

spots.name: Bun cha ca
spots.note: Fish cake in a broth Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says is simmered mainly from fish bone and fish head, with a chili sauce it calls particular to Binh Dinh. Báo Người Lao Động, 3 Apr 2019, says the broth is not pork bone, usually tuna or sailfish, and that the cake has no dill. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cha ca
spots.note: Tuna cake from Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định. The same office says a good cake is also the ingredient in bún chả cá. Fried, it is chewy and crisp. Steamed, it carries a thin yellow egg layer. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh hoi long heo
spots.note: Fine rice sheets with sliced pork intestine and pork, a bowl of hot porridge, and a slightly sweet garlic-chili fish sauce. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định calls it a morning plate and traces it to Diêu Trì. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh it la gai
spots.note: A cone of ramie leaf and fresh sticky-rice flour, with a mung-bean and dried-coconut filling. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định addresses it to Quy Nhon. Tháp Bánh Ít is a Cham tower, not this cake. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Chao bo
spots.note: Beef porridge. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says the broth is beef bone, with scallion and sawtooth, and that the bowl is full of tendon, bone, and beef offal. It names gỏi bò as the plate beside it. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Goi bo
spots.note: Named by Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định as the plate beside cháo bò in Quy Nhon. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định does not describe the salad. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bun rieu cua
spots.note: Crab noodle soup. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says the crab is pounded, mixed with egg, and set into brown-gold sheets, with seaweed in the pot and a full herb plate. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Goi ca chich
spots.note: A small freshwater fish. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says it is fried whole and eaten in a phở sheet with herbs and cucumber, or served raw after the bones are taken out. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Chao cau gai
spots.note: Sea-urchin porridge. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says only a fresh urchin is worth the pot: the meat and the roe are seasoned, stir-fried, and poured into boiling rice. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh xeo tom nhay
spots.address: Diên Hồng and Đống Đa; Mỹ Cang, Tuy Phước
spots.note: The shrimp pancake. Báo Người Lao Động describes a thin yellow batter, small freshwater shrimp that turn red, bean sprouts, and scallion. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định, on the Mỹ Cang plate, says the shrimp is brackish tôm đất from the Thị Nại lagoon. Both stay. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bun nem
spots.address: The center. A street was not printed.
spots.note: Fresh noodles, nem chua, and grilled fish cake. Báo Người Lao Động, 3 Apr 2019, adds herbs, peanut, pickled mustard, and coriander, and a sour-hot-salty-sweet sauce that changes by shop. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh mi lagu
spots.note: A thick soup with a large piece of pork, eaten with bread. Báo Người Lao Động, 3 Apr 2019, places it in a small lane off Nguyễn Huệ and says to eat it hot. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Hu tieu mi hoanh thanh
spots.note: A breakfast bowl in the center. Báo Người Lao Động, 3 Apr 2019, places a Hoa family shop on Ngô Thời Nhiệm, nearly 50 years old, with phở, hủ tiếu, and hoành thánh as the three dishes. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh beo
spots.address: Nguyễn Tất Thành nối dài, Nguyễn Thái Học, and Mai Xuân Thưởng
spots.note: Named by Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định on 2 May 2019 as a cheap cake younger visitors eat. The piece does not describe the cake. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Nem nuong
spots.address: Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở
spots.note: Named by Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định on 2 May 2019 among the night snacks on Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở. A recipe was not printed. It is not nem chợ huyện. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh trang trung
spots.address: Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở
spots.note: Named by Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định on 2 May 2019 with the night snacks on Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở. A recipe was not printed. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh canh
spots.address: Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở
spots.note: Named by Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định on 2 May 2019 with the night snacks on Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở. A broth was not printed. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ca muc kho nuong
spots.address: Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở
spots.note: Grilled dried fish and squid, named by Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định on 2 May 2019 with the night snacks on Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở. A species list was not printed. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Oc
spots.address: Tăng Bạt Hổ, Mai Xuân Thưởng, and Đào Duy Từ
spots.note: Snails, on three streets. Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định, 2 May 2019, says the shops sell many kinds and does not name the species. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Rong bien
spots.note: Seaweed from the Bãi Xếp fishing village. A 4 Feb 2021 article on Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định says residents dry it for a cool summer drink and also cook it with chè. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ruou Bau Da
spots.address: Cù Lâm, Nhơn Lộc, An Nhơn; with seafood at Hòn Khô
spots.note: A rice spirit Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định places at Cù Lâm, Nhơn Lộc, An Nhơn, and calls stronger than 50 degrees. Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định says the seafood at Hòn Khô is drunk with it. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Elsewhere in Binh Dinh
paragraphs: Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định lists these outside the city. Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định also names nem chợ huyện, bún Song Thằn, and bánh tráng nước dừa in its introduction, and does not describe them there. The descriptions below are the provincial accounts. They are not beach stalls.

spots.name: Nem cho huyen
spots.note: Fermented pork from Tuy Phước. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says it is neither as soft as nem Thủ Đức nor as sweet as nem Lai Vung or nem An Cựu. The city tourism introduction names it and does not describe it. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bun song than
spots.note: Mung-bean noodles from An Thái. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says the name comes from pulling the strands in pairs, and that some people say song thần. The city tourism introduction names the bowl and does not describe it. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh trang nuoc dua
spots.note: Coconut rice cracker from Tam Quan. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says coconut milk goes into the rice batter, and that the cracker is grilled, not eaten soft. The city tourism introduction names it and does not describe it. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Chim mia
spots.note: A small bird from the Tây Sơn cane fields. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says it is the color of a dry leaf and appears in late winter and early spring. Phú Phong is the town Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định prints. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bun tom Chau Truc
spots.note: Shrimp noodles from Châu Trúc, on the Trà Ổ lagoon. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says the shrimp is pounded live from that lagoon and stirred into boiling noodle water. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Mam nhum
spots.note: Fermented black sea urchin from Mỹ An, Phù Mỹ. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says it was once sent to the king, and that it is often not for sale. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cua huynh de
spots.note: A crab the provincial portal calls the king of crabs, from Tam Quan and Đề Gi. It is yellow, heavily spined, and scarce. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định puts the season at lunar month 12 through lunar month 3. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Gie bo
spots.note: A Bahnar beef broth that Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says began in the highlands of An Khê and Vĩnh Thạnh and is now also eaten in Tây Sơn. The broth is the fresh small intestine, finished sour with lá giang. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh uot Hoai Nhon
spots.note: Steamed rice sheets stacked in layers. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định addresses them to thị xã Hoài Nhơn and, in the prose, to huyện Hoài Nhơn. Both stay. The hour, where none was printed, is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Streets
paragraphs: Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định, 2 May 2019, names the streets. The same piece also names kem ly, kem trộn, and sinh tố on Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở, and does not print a recipe. A stall price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Xuan Dieu
spots.note: Evening seafood, in the 2 May 2019 article on Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định, along Xuân Diệu, and again near the Quy Nhơn–Nhơn Hội bridge. The beach field of 6:00–23:00 is the sand, not a restaurant clock. A shop hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Dien Hong and Dong Da
spots.note: The 2 May 2019 article on Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định places bánh xèo tôm nhảy here. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Phan Boi Chau and Ngo Van So
spots.nameVi: Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở
spots.address: Phan Bội Châu and Ngô Văn Sở
spots.note: Night snacks on the 2 May 2019 piece: nem nướng, bánh tráng trứng, bánh canh, bánh xèo, kem ly, kem trộn, sinh tố, and cá mực khô nướng. Numbers 185–187 Phan Bội Châu are the tourism office, not a stall.

spots.name: Snail streets
spots.nameVi: Tăng Bạt Hổ, Mai Xuân Thưởng, Đào Duy Từ
spots.address: Tăng Bạt Hổ, Mai Xuân Thưởng, and Đào Duy Từ
spots.note: The 2 May 2019 piece sends ốc to these three streets and does not name the species. A shop hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Nguyen Hue
spots.note: Báo Người Lao Động places bún chả cá on this street and bánh mì lagu in a lane off it. The 2 May 2019 tourism article also sends seafood here. Number 26 is the museum.

spots.name: Night market
spots.note: The 2 May 2019 piece puts a food corner inside Nhà Văn hóa Lao động tỉnh and calls the market a walking street for clothes and souvenirs. The street was not printed. Hours are Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Breakfast
paragraphs: Bánh hỏi is the morning plate Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định traces to Diêu Trì. Báo Người Lao Động calls hủ tiếu mì hoành thánh a center breakfast on Ngô Thời Nhiệm, and places bún chả cá on Nguyễn Huệ without printing a clock. A shop hour is Check on arrival.
